model.name: KAAM
model.description: canonical KAAM: full trace, random split 42, seed 0

plan_cpu.label: CPU request
plan_cpu.help: CPU cores the task asked for.

plan_gpu.label: GPU request
plan_gpu.help: GPUs the task asked for; fractions share a GPU.

avg_cpu_usr.label: Machine user CPU
avg_cpu_usr.help: User-space CPU on the assigned machine, averaged over other jobs that ended there in the hour before the task started.

avg_gpu_util.label: Machine GPU use
avg_gpu_util.help: GPU utilisation on the machine in the same hour, summed over its GPUs, so values above 100% are normal.

avg_cpu_kernel.label: Machine kernel CPU
avg_cpu_kernel.help: Kernel-space CPU on the machine in the same hour.

avg_load_1.label: Machine load
avg_load_1.help: 1-minute load average on the machine in the same hour.

avg_net_receive.label: Machine network in
avg_net_receive.help: Network receive rate on the machine in the same hour.

preprocess.note: Clip each raw value to the training 1st and 99th percentiles, then min-max scale with the clipped training range (the model's input). The curves here are already in raw units, so the page only clips.

paper.score: test ROC-AUC: mean over test sets of the mean over five seeds, 95% bootstrap interval (users resampled for the user-grouped split)
